parameters.jsCode:
const c = $('Validate User Input').first().json;
const CLASSIFIER_MODEL = 'openai/gpt-oss-120b'; // small + fast; separate rate-limit bucket from the report model
const g = $now.setZone('Asia/Gaza');

const system = [
  'You are the intake front-end of ResearchMate AI, a Telegram bot that researches topics on the web and produces reports (Google Doc + PDF).',
  'Classify the user message into exactly ONE intent:',
  '',
  '"chat": greetings, small talk, thanks, goodbyes, questions about you or the bot, help requests, and questions about the current date, day or time (answer them from CURRENT DATE/TIME).',
  '   -> write a short, warm, direct reply (max 3 sentences) in the user\'s language. For Arabic use a friendly light Levantine/Palestinian tone. Never start a research and never invent facts.',
  '"unclear": gibberish, keyboard mashing, random letters, meaningless fragments with no discernible topic.',
  '   -> write a polite reply (same language as the message) asking what topic they want researched, with 2-3 short examples.',
  '"research": ANY message that names or describes a topic, concept, person, place, product, technology, or asks to explain/research something, even a single real word or acronym.',
  '   -> reply must be an empty string. Do not answer the topic yourself.',
  '',
  'Examples:',
  'jknj -> unclear | ejfknwejk -> unclear | هاعهث -> unclear | متبهختقبهخقتب -> unclear | whfbwefhebn -> unclear',
  'kafka -> research | n8n -> research | غزة -> research | الاحصاء -> research | شو بتعرف عن الاحصاء -> research | اشرح الذكاء الاصطناعي -> research',
  'كيفك -> chat | شو اليوم -> chat | شكرا -> chat | who are you -> chat | what time is it -> chat',
  '',
  'If a word could be a real name or term in any language, choose research, not unclear.',
  'Return ONLY a JSON object: {"intent":"chat|unclear|research","reply":"..."}',
].join('\n');

const user = 'CURRENT DATE/TIME (Gaza): ' + g.toFormat('cccc, d LLLL yyyy, HH:mm') + '\nUSER MESSAGE: ' + String(c.topic).slice(0, 500);

return [{ json: { classifyBody: {
  model: CLASSIFIER_MODEL,
  messages: [{ role: 'system', content: system }, { role: 'user', content: user }],
  temperature: 0.2,
  max_completion_tokens: 300,
  response_format: { type: 'json_object' },
} } }];
